section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single (unnamed) study of Chinese adolescent girls (ages 11–15) recruited from four public schools in Wuhan, Hubei province, with 1,152 questionnaires included in the analysis. Data were collected via a pencil-and-paper questionnaire over ~2 months that assessed online behaviors, body appreciation, eating behaviors, and self-reported weight and height. The section does not report mean age, mean BMI, racial composition, the specific body appreciation instrument (BAS/BAS-2), or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
